title: Italian-Style Kabanos Crumble
description: A creative twist on the classic Italian dish, combining the flavors of roasted vegetables with the smoky taste of kabanos and topped with a crunchy crumble.
instructions: Slice the kabanos sausage into 1-inch pieces and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned.
Add the roasted bell peppers and zucchini to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with mozzarella cheese.
In a separate bowl, mix together breadcrumbs and parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle the breadcrumb mixture evenly over the top of the mozzarella cheese.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with fresh basil.
